alternatives.reason: The kidney signal and marrow precursors also address renewal, but I chose to start with skin.

reaction: The result was clear but brief.

reaction: The low-oxygen cue usefully connects the kidney to blood renewal.

reaction: The new bone goal extends renewal beyond skin and blood.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should begin remodelling the existing bone.
expectation: I expect the bone-removing cells to break down a patch of bone, leaving it ready for rebuilding.

effect: The bone patch shows removal of old bone, leaving the forming cells as the next step.
reaction: The removal is clear, though the picture gives little detail about how it happens.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should complete the bone-remodelling sequence.
expectation: I expect the bone-forming cells to deposit new bone in the remodelled patch.

effect: The rebuilt bone patch completes the remodelling goal and brings skin, blood and bone renewal together in the same body.
reaction: The final picture is a satisfying connection to the arm and wound built earlier, though the bone mechanism remains brief.

mostWorthwhile.text: The kidney-to-marrow sequence was most worthwhile: low oxygen prompts a blood-borne signal, connecting kidney function to red-cell renewal.

leastWorthwhile.text: The bone-removal passage was least informative: the planned picture shows old bone disappearing but gives little sense of how the cells remove it.

surprise.text: Completing skin and blood renewal revealed a bone-remodelling goal, extending the idea of renewal to existing bone.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, although after the first choice each combination was the only offered gameplay action, making the sequence predictable.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter that connects systems as the kidney and marrow sequence did, but the largely predetermined actions and brief bone explanation limit the appeal.
